entries.text:
SEC. 573. INCREASE IN NUMBER OF PERMANENT PROFESSORS AT THE UNITED 
                        STATES AIR FORCE ACADEMY.

    Section 9431(b)(4) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by 
striking ``23'' and inserting ``25''.
